      theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.cone_interior_torsion_identities {R : Type u} [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] (P : TwoTerm R) (hp : P.IsPresilting) {v : RealProjectiveSpace R} (hv : v ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ ↑P.gVectorCone) (M : FGModuleCat R) :
      have θ := fun (X : FGModuleCat R) => (realEulerEvaluation k (GrothendieckGroup.of X)) v; ((∀ {Q : FGModuleCat R} (q : M ⟶ Q) [CategoryTheory.Epi q], ¬CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero Q → 0 < θ Q) ↔ IsGeneratedBy (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel P.differential) M) ∧ ((∀ {Q : FGModuleCat R} (q : M ⟶ Q) [CategoryTheory.Epi q], 0 ≤ θ Q) ↔ Subsingleton (M ⟶ nakayamaKernel k P)) ∧ ((∀ {U : FGModuleCat R} (i : U ⟶ M) [CategoryTheory.Mono i], θ U ≤ 0) ↔ Subsingleton (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel P.differential ⟶ M)) ∧ ((∀ {U : FGModuleCat R} (i : U ⟶ M) [CategoryTheory.Mono i], ¬CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero U → θ U < 0) ↔ cogeneratedByModule (nakayamaKernel k P).obj M) ∧ (v ∈ realStabilityWall k M ↔ Subsingleton (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel P.differential ⟶ M) ∧ Subsingleton (M ⟶ nakayamaKernel k P))

      All four numerical torsion and torsion-free classes, and the semistable subcategory, at an arbitrary real weight in the relative interior of C(P).

      LinearIndependent ℚ fun (x : { c : CategoryTheory.Skeleton (FGModuleCat R) // RealStableAt k v ((CategoryTheory.fromSkeleton (FGModuleCat R)).obj c) }) => 1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] GrothendieckGroup.of ((CategoryTheory.fromSkeleton (FGModuleCat R)).obj ↑x)

      theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.silting_interior_signs {R : Type u} [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] (P : TwoTerm R) (hp : P.IsPresilting) (hgen : ∀ (Z : (boundedProjective R).FullSubcategory), (CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.singleton P.inBoundedProjectives).triangEnvelope Z) {v : RealProjectiveSpace R} (hv : v ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ ↑P.gVectorCone) :
      have T := IsGeneratedBy (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel P.differential); have F := fun (Y : FGModuleCat R) => ∀ (X : FGModuleCat R), T X → Subsingleton (X ⟶ Y); have θ := fun (X : FGModuleCat R) => (realEulerEvaluation k (GrothendieckGroup.of X)) v; (∀ (X : FGModuleCat R), T X → ¬CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero X → 0 < θ X) ∧ (∀ (Y : FGModuleCat R), F Y → ¬CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero Y → θ Y < 0) ∧ ∀ (X Y : FGModuleCat R), T X → ¬CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero X → F Y → GrothendieckGroup.of X ≠ GrothendieckGroup.of Y

      An interior weight of a two-term silting cone strictly separates the nonzero generated modules from their right orthogonal.
